notes: Mail Info import now reads MetaMax / MaxCare combos on its own (Smart auto-detect: email, password, recovery mail and proxy are found by their shape, in any column order, split on | : ; tab or ----). Hotmail Add Recovery Mail has two choices: Just Add Mail, or Add Mail then Remove Old recovery mail - it adds the new mail, then removes the account's other recovery mails (recently-added ones go at once; a long-standing one Microsoft schedules for later).
